description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin command class 'ToggleDrupalMediaCaptionCommand' that manages toggling captions on Drupal media elements within the editor, including showing, hiding, and restoring captions.

classes.name: ToggleDrupalMediaCaptionCommand
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 command class that toggles captions on Drupal media elements, allowing adding, removing, and restoring captions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the command's enabled state and value based on the current selection.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the toggle command, either showing or hiding the caption based on current state.

methods.name: _showDrupalMediaCaption
methods.description: Shows the caption for the selected Drupal media element, restoring saved caption if available.

methods.name: _hideDrupalMediaCaption
methods.description: Hides the caption for the selected Drupal media element, saving its content for potential restoration.
